query: For my 57‑year‑old male stroke patient: among males 52–62, by ICU vs non‑ICU, LOS ≤5 vs >5 days and comorbidity tertile, report in‑hospital mortality (%) and CKD and diabetes prevalence (%).
final_sql:
WITH PatientCohort AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age,
    a.deathtime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.admittime,
    a.hospital_expire_flag,
    a.los AS hospital_los,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_gt_5,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_le_5,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_1,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_1,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_2,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_2,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_3,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_3,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_4,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_4,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_5,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_5,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_6,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_6,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_7,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_7,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_8,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_8,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5_flag_9,
    CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_gt5_flag_9,
    CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS los_category_le5;
